q: Tell me about Silent Valley National Park.
reply:
Silent Valley National Park is a pristine tropical evergreen rainforest nestled in the Western Ghats of Palakkad district. Renowned for its untouched wilderness and rich biodiversity, it serves as a critical haven for rare and endangered species, most notably the lion-tailed macaque, Nilgiri tahr, and unique endemic flora. 

Eco-tourism entry is coordinated via the forest department base at Mukkali, where guided safaris into the buffer zone are arranged. 

For more details on exploring destinations across the district, check `/places.php` on our website.
